title: Which integrations Track3D supports, and how deep
question: Which third-party integrations are part of the product (Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Fieldwire, Togal, Power BI, Slack, wearables, Keystone), for which customers, and which data does each carry?
context: The prior PRDs describe broad Procore sync (RFIs, observations, submittals, photos, embedding) and several others. The code shows project linking, design import and pass-through calls for Procore and Autodesk, Fieldwire task import, a Togal endpoint that stores nothing, and no Power BI, wearable or Keystone code in the repositories read.
